top_signals.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
top_signals.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Top Chinese diplomat tells ex-Japanese foreign minister ties must be ‘normalized’
top_signals.summary: Former Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya has met with China's top diplomat in the first such official meeting since ties faltered over Taiwan last year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China Expands Travel Curbs to Top AI Talent and Families
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Minmin Low says China is broadening travel restrictions to top AI talent and their families, a national security measure that risks stalling recruitment and innovation across the tech sector. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China to Launch New Pro-Growth Policies
top_signals.summary: China's government will introduce new measures to support the economy and study policies to stabilize the property market. Bloomberg Economics Chief Asia Economist Chang Shu says the acceleration will likely target investment rather than purely addressing flatlining consumption. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
